articles.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
articles.snippet: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Next Move: Bullish Bets Run Up Against a Historical Wall
articles.snippet: Bitcoin just had one its best months in years amid a price rally that broke the crypto winter pattern. But the charts tell a complicated story.

articles.title: George Santos Bet on Whether He'd Show Up to the State of the Union—Kalshi Just Banned Him for Life
articles.snippet: The exchange found the former congressman placed large trades on his own State of the Union attendance, then made false statements to move prices, profiting nearly $18,000.
